leaves.name: grothendieckOrthogonalitySS
leaves.doc: sga7-35-proof, consequence: Grothendieck's orthogonality theorem in the semistable case at finite level (SGA 7 I Exp. IX Thm 2.4 with the rank count of the proof of Prop. 3.5; numbers UNVERIFIED): over a strictly henselian DVR O, l invertible in O, A semistable at O, B = Pic0 its dual and e Mumford's Weil pairing A[l^n] x B[l^n] -> mu_{l^n} (pinned by weilScalar), a point of A[l^n] orthogonal to the G_K-invariants of B[l^n] is G_K-invariant. With picRepresentableAbVar, picZeroAbVar and weilPairingMumford replaces sga7_IX_3_5_ForwardGeom (the Galois glue, mu_{l^n} in K by Hensel and the K^s/Kbar passage are proved).
leaves.flag: consequence of SGA 7 IX Thm 2.4 (orthogonality: T_t is the kernel of the pairing on T_f x T'_f), the rank formulas rank T_f = 2a + t for A and its dual, the saturation/direct-summand argument and the comparison of Mumford's e_n with SGA 7's biextension pairing up to sign; locators UNVERIFIED; fold NOT recommended (raises the GLUE count by one)
leaves.source: SGA 7 I, Exp. IX, Thm 2.4 (orthogonality theorem) and the proof of Prop. 3.5 (semistable case: (T'_f)^perp = T_t inside T_f), read at finite level with Mumford's Weil pairing (numbers UNVERIFIED); sga7-35-proof
